title: Equation
description: A formula set large: x1 becomes x with a small 1, theta becomes the Greek letter, letters are set in italic. The terms arrive one by one, a cases form gets a brace that draws itself, and the symbols can be explained underneath.

props.eq: the formula as plain text, for example A = XW + B (or use cases)
props.lhs: with cases: the left side, for example y
props.cases: 2-3 of {value, when}: y is value when the condition holds
props.terms: up to 4 of {sym, text}: a symbol and what it means, shown under the formula
props.title: heading
